quote: Man what an amazing women and talent! Our daughter hates her pictures being taken and had a melt down with alligator tears and some how she happened to capture the most perfect heart felt shots! Unfortunately our grumpy toddler made her work for it... she had such poise grace and most impressively patience and understanding! These are more then pictures; she captured such a pure and sweet unforgettable moment in our lives and I’m forever be grateful!
name: Hanna Lnenicka
